_provenance: Hand-constructed to match Claude-on-Vertex-AI's `:rawPredict` response, documented at https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/claude-on-vertex-ai as the Anthropic Messages API body (Vertex adds only an `anthropic_version` discriminator to the REQUEST; the response is the native Messages shape), fed as-is (minus this key) to `vertex.parse_reply()` in src/fleet/llm/backends/vertex.py, whose `_content_blocks`/`_usage`/`_finish_reason` read exactly these snake_case top-level keys (`content`, `stop_reason`, `usage.input_tokens`/`usage.output_tokens`) — the same shape that module's own `raw_predict_body()` test helper builds. Rung: TOOL_CALL, matching `build_body()`'s tool branch. Envelope shape is identical to the REPO_CLASSIFY fixture in this same directory (`vertex_tool_call.json`) by design: `_TOOL_NAME = "emit_response"` (src/fleet/llm/backends/vertex.py:92) is a role-agnostic constant and `parse_reply` never introspects `content[0].input`'s internal shape, so only the `input` payload below (a `CycleBreakProposal`-schema object) differs. `strategy` is a bare JSON string (`"ATOMIC_WAVE"`); `BreakStrategy` (a `StrEnum`) coerces it the same way `RepoClassification.ecosystem` already does in `vertex_tool_call.json`.

input.rationale: Every edge in this SCC is a shared-resource dependency; no single edge can be broken without breaking the build, so the whole SCC migrates as one indivisible wave.
